verdicts.reason: I'd ship neither, but B is less broken. In A, the headline is oversized and almost touches the top edge, and it wraps so 'fizz' sits alone on the second line. The product can is small and pushed to the left on a circle. The fine print beside the button is too small to read and also leaves 'details.' alone on its last line, and the button is jammed against the bottom. In B, the headline stays on one line and the headline, button and fine print form a tidy group. However, that group hugs the right edge and sits low, leaving a large empty area at the top right. The can almost touches the bottom edge, and the logo floats on its own at the top left, so the layout feels lopsided.
